digest.component_or_area: Binding store retirement recovery and reconciliation
propositions: A crash after retired tombstone replacement but before live replacement leaves the same identity in both live and retired states; this partial state is detectable and safely completable but violates read-only constraints at construction or preview time

Pre-observation recovery of interrupted retirement must execute after under-lock staleness validation but before the first remote issue fetch, requiring invocation in reconcile.py immediately after staleness gate rather than in run_differs.py

The durable tombstone is the authoritative retirement intent; completion removes the redundant live pair only when tombstone, forward, and reverse identities agree exactly, with repeat being a no-op and any mismatch causing safety-abort
A later automatic 200/clear_absent/same-key confirm does not implicitly resurrect a tombstoned identity; only explicit unretire removes the tombstone intent and prevents completion
Production code must not mutate entries obtained from all_bindings(); rich-text handler must use the narrow S2 facade operation instead
Keyed pending recovery performs no search; keyless requires both three misses and 3600-second conjunction; per-entry failures remain nonfatal to other entries
